title: Local development execution contract v0
description: Version 0 is the development fixture contract. Version 1 accepts one workflow job and leaves it queued. Select a $defs entry for requests, per-method responses, or durable run records. Transport and stateful rules are in docs/design/development-contract.md.

output.description: At most 65536 UTF-8 bytes; enable the documented custom format check.

steps.description: Stored step records. GitHub documents no per-job step limit. https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits

cancel_requested.description: True when the caller cancelled the run. False when the job timeout cancelled it. https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax
True when the caller cancelled and cleanup could not be shown. False when a restart marked the run lost.

retention.const: runs and submission keys retained indefinitely; pruning unsupported
